microtheory.name: computer_vision
microtheory.definition: Algorithmic + statistical approaches to visual recognition + understanding. Image processing, feature extraction, classification, deep learning. Substrate analogue: the computational substrate of substrate's visual processing.

concepts.name: image_representation
concepts.definition: Pixel arrays, color spaces, image formats (JPEG, PNG). Substrate analogue: substrate's visual input encoding.

concepts.name: pixel
concepts.definition: Picture element. Smallest addressable unit in raster image. RGB triple. Substrate analogue: substrate's atomic visual sample.

concepts.name: image_processing
concepts.definition: Operations on images: filtering, transforming, enhancing. Substrate analogue: substrate's pre-processing.

concepts.name: gaussian_blur
concepts.definition: Convolution with Gaussian kernel. Noise reduction. Substrate analogue: substrate's smoothing pre-filter.

concepts.name: median_filter
concepts.definition: Replace each pixel with median of neighborhood. Removes salt-and-pepper noise + preserves edges. Substrate analogue: substrate's robust local filter.

concepts.name: morphological_operations
concepts.definition: Erosion, dilation, opening, closing. Shape-based operations on binary images. Substrate analogue: substrate's binary-pattern operations.

concepts.name: sift
concepts.definition: Scale-Invariant Feature Transform. Lowe 2004. Keypoints + descriptors invariant to scale + rotation. Substrate analogue: substrate's invariant-feature extractor.

concepts.name: hog
concepts.definition: Histogram of Oriented Gradients. Dalal + Triggs. Used for pedestrian detection. Substrate analogue: substrate's edge-statistics feature.

concepts.name: orb_features
concepts.definition: Oriented FAST + Rotated BRIEF. Fast keypoint detector + binary descriptor. Substrate analogue: substrate's efficient feature.

concepts.name: harris_corner
concepts.definition: Corner detector via gradient covariance. Substrate analogue: substrate's structural-corner feature.

concepts.name: convolutional_layer
concepts.definition: Learnable filters applied across image. Local connectivity + weight sharing. Substrate analogue: substrate's local feature detector.

concepts.name: pooling_layer
concepts.definition: Downsamples — max or average pool. Adds invariance, reduces dimensionality. Substrate analogue: substrate's pooling-for-invariance.

concepts.name: batch_normalization
concepts.definition: Ioffe + Szegedy 2015. Normalize activations within mini-batch. Stabilizes training. Substrate analogue: substrate's per-layer normalization.

concepts.name: residual_connection_vision
concepts.definition: ResNet He 2015. Skip connection bypassing layers. Enables very deep networks. Substrate analogue: substrate's identity-shortcut in deep computation.

concepts.name: resnet
concepts.definition: He 2015. Deep residual networks. Won ImageNet 2015. 152+ layers. Substrate analogue: substrate's very-deep architecture.

concepts.name: efficient_net
concepts.definition: Tan + Le 2019. Compound scaling of depth + width + resolution. Substrate analogue: substrate's balanced-scale architecture.

concepts.name: object_detection_systems
concepts.definition: Locate + classify objects. R-CNN family, YOLO, SSD, DETR. Substrate analogue: substrate's spatial-object recognition system.

concepts.name: faster_rcnn
concepts.definition: Region Proposal Network + classifier. Ren 2015. Substrate analogue: substrate's two-stage detector.

concepts.name: yolo
concepts.definition: You Only Look Once. Redmon. Single-pass detection. Real-time. Substrate analogue: substrate's single-pass spatial detector.

concepts.name: mask_rcnn
concepts.definition: He 2017. Adds instance segmentation to Faster R-CNN. Substrate analogue: substrate's spatial-mask producer.

concepts.name: image_classification_systems
concepts.definition: AlexNet, VGG, GoogLeNet, ResNet, EfficientNet, ViT. Substrate analogue: substrate's category-classifier architectures.

concepts.name: semantic_segmentation_systems
concepts.definition: FCN, U-Net, DeepLab. Pixel-level classification. Substrate analogue: substrate's pixel-Concept system.

concepts.name: instance_segmentation_systems
concepts.definition: Mask R-CNN, DETR, Mask2Former. Distinguishes instances of same class. Substrate analogue: substrate's per-instance Concept.

concepts.name: data_augmentation
concepts.definition: Transform training images (rotate, flip, color jitter) to enlarge dataset. Mixup, CutMix. Substrate analogue: substrate's invariance-training via input transformation.

concepts.name: transfer_learning_vision_models
concepts.definition: Pre-train on ImageNet, fine-tune on target task. Hugely successful. Substrate analogue: substrate's foundational pre-training pattern.

concepts.name: self_supervised_vision
concepts.definition: Learn from images without labels. Contrastive (SimCLR, MoCo), masked image modeling (MAE). Substrate analogue: substrate's self-grounded learning.

concepts.name: contrastive_learning
concepts.definition: Train to bring similar pairs close + push dissimilar apart in representation space. Substrate analogue: substrate's similarity-driven learning.

concepts.name: diffusion_model_vision
concepts.definition: Generative model via noise → image denoising chain. DALL-E 2, Stable Diffusion. Substrate analogue: substrate's noise-to-pattern generative process.

concepts.name: gan
concepts.definition: Generative Adversarial Network. Goodfellow 2014. Generator vs discriminator. Substrate analogue: substrate's adversarial-training pattern.

concepts.name: variational_autoencoder
concepts.definition: VAE. Probabilistic generative model with continuous latent space. Substrate analogue: substrate's probabilistic-latent encoding.

concepts.name: neural_radiance_field
concepts.definition: NeRF. Mildenhall 2020. Render novel views of scene from sparse observations. Substrate analogue: substrate's view-synthesis from observations.

concepts.name: vision_language_model
concepts.definition: CLIP, ALIGN, Flamingo. Joint vision + language representation. Zero-shot classification. Substrate analogue: substrate's multimodal Concept space.

concepts.name: clip
concepts.definition: Radford 2021. Contrastive language-image pretraining. Aligns text + image embeddings. Substrate analogue: substrate's cross-modal Concept binding.

rules.name: convolution_provides_translation_invariance
rules.head: the substrate processes spatial input
rules.body: convolution applies same operation across positions — translation equivariance. With pooling, becomes invariance. Substrate's translation-handling.

rules.name: pooling_trades_spatial_resolution_for_invariance
rules.head: the substrate pools features over neighborhood
rules.body: spatial resolution decreases; invariance to small shifts increases. Substrate's pooling tradeoff.

rules.name: residual_connections_enable_deep_training
rules.head: the substrate trains very deep networks
rules.body: residual (skip) connections preserve gradient flow + identity, enabling 100+ layer training. He 2015. Substrate's deep-architecture pattern.

rules.name: transfer_learning_amortizes_pretraining
rules.head: the substrate has limited labeled data for a task
rules.body: pre-training on large datasets + fine-tuning on target outperforms training from scratch. Substrate's foundational-knowledge transfer.

rules.name: self_supervised_learning_scales_without_labels
rules.head: the substrate has abundant unlabeled images
rules.body: self-supervised objectives (contrastive, masked modeling) learn useful representations. Substrate's self-grounded learning.
